answer: Resist sybils with a slashable locked bond plus unique attested work. Each identity locks an umber stake for N epochs and submits one original, hash-unique answer that peers countersign. Juries cluster accounts by answer structure, key reuse, and timing; if two collapse to one operator, both bonds burn and their votes void. Cost then scales with herd size: every sockpuppet needs a fresh locked stake and real writing, and funds stay frozen on a velvet delay long enough for fraud proofs. Verdicts sit on a shale append-only log, so rewriting history costs more than honest work.
